rubric.why: Identifies the pericardium as the membrane or sac around the heart.
rubric.description: The pericardium is a double-walled sac surrounding the heart.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as a double-walled sac or membrane surrounding the heart.

rubric.why: States how the pericardium helps the heart beat smoothly.
rubric.description: Fluid between the pericardial walls reduces friction as the heart beats.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that pericardial fluid reduces friction during heartbeats.

modelAnswer: The pericardium is a double-walled sac surrounding the heart.
The fluid between its walls reduces friction as the heart beats.
